answer: The fee is charged through an anchor debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the trellis totals, and the orchard anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 22 units per epoch, sustaining 50 aliases for 38 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the copycat. Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 27 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
